verdict.rationale: An operating system with built-in AI features (Copilot, Windows AI APIs, AI Foundry toolkit) could plausibly let users plug in MCP servers, so this story applies to Windows. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP support or any way to register external tool servers. The AI-related items cover Copilot in Office apps, local AI APIs and developer toolkits, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.
